description: Guided Connection Wizard - Replace the simple connector form with a step-by-step wizard that provides clear instructions for each integration setup
steps: 1. Modify the SettingsPanel.render() method in dashboard/connectors.js to render a multi-step wizard UI instead of the current flat form when a user clicks 'Connect'. The wizard should have: a step indicator (Step 1 of 3), content area, and Next/Back/Connect buttons.

2. For Shopify: Step 1 shows instructions: 'Go to your Shopify admin > Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps. Create or open a custom app.' with a visual screenshot placeholder. Step 2: 'Under API credentials, copy your Admin API access token (starts with shpat_)'. Step 3: Form fields for store subdomain and token, with an inline test button.

3. For GitHub: Step 1: 'Go to GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens > Generate new token'. Step 2: 'Select scopes: repo, read:org'. Step 3: Form fields for token and owner/org.
4. For other connectors (GA4, Search Console, Stripe): Similar guided steps appropriate to each service.
5. Add CSS for the wizard UI in dashboard/styles.css: Step progress indicator with numbered circles, animated transitions between steps, clear instruction blocks with code/highlight formatting.
6. Add a validate function in the wizard that checks input format before allowing progression (e.g., Shopify token must start with 'shpat_', GitHub token with 'ghp_' or 'github_pat_').
7. Run npm test and npm run build to verify.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking Connect on a connector opens a multi-step wizard instead of showing a flat form
Shopify wizard has 3 steps with clear instructions at each step
GitHub wizard has 3 steps with clear instructions
Input validation provides immediate feedback on token format
Back button allows returning to previous steps
Final step connects and shows success/failure status inline
verification: Run npm test and confirm all tests pass
Run npm run build and confirm it succeeds
findings: All 275 tests pass. Build succeeds. Wizard replaces the flat connector form with a 3-step guided flow for all 5 connectors. OAuth buttons preserved for Shopify and GitHub. Input validation checks token prefixes (shpat_, ghp_, github_pat_). Vite non-module warnings are expected and by design.
